Introduction

Arrival is a South Korean virtual boy group under Familya Entertainment. The group consists of four members: Reo, Jyan, Xi:on, and B-0. They debuted on April 10, 2024, with the single "Drop".

The debut lineup consisted of Reo, Jyan, Xi:on, and Ryota, but on June 10, 2024, Familya Entertainment announced Ryota's departure due to personal matters. On June 11, Ryota gave his final farewell broadcast.

On June 23, the new member, B-0, was announced, making his debut with the group on the second single, "New Chapter".
